notes: Mature consumer-robotics (Roomba) maker. 10-K filed 2025-03-12 covering FY2024. Filings index also shows distress fingerprints post-cutoff window: 25-NSE delisting filing 2026-01-15 and Form 15-12G deregistration 2026-01-26, with POSASR + multiple S-8 POS on 2025-12-31 (suggesting strategic transaction completion). Going-concern qualifier + Carlyle term loan covenant breach + strategic review already disclosed in 10-K.

claims.claim_text: iRobot has sold over 50 million consumer robots worldwide since the Roomba introduction in 2002.
claims.subject: iRobot Corp.
claims.source_quote: Following the introduction of the Roomba robotic vacuum cleaner ("RVC") in 2002, we have sold over 50 million consumer robots worldwide to become a global, market-leading consumer robotics innovator.

claims.claim_text: One customer accounted for 22.2% of total revenue in fiscal 2024 (24.0% in 2023, 22.6% in 2022) — a customer concentration >10% threshold disclosable in 10-K.
claims.subject: iRobot Corp.
claims.object_value: one customer = 22.2% of FY2024 revenue ($681.8M total => ~$151M from that customer)
claims.source_quote: For the fiscal years ended December 28, 2024, December 30, 2023, and December 31, 2022, there was one customer that accounted for 10% or more of total revenue, representing 22.2%, 24.0% and 22.6%, of total revenue, respectively.

claims.claim_text: On January 28, 2024, iRobot and Amazon mutually terminated the merger agreement; Amazon paid a $94.0 million Parent Termination Fee on January 29, 2024.
claims.subject: iRobot Corp.
claims.object_value: $94.0 million termination fee paid by Amazon
claims.source_quote: On January 28, 2024, we and Amazon mutually agreed to terminate the Merger Agreement... Amazon made a cash payment to us in the previously agreed amount of $94.0 million (the "Parent Termination Fee") on January 29, 2024.

claims.claim_text: iRobot received a going-concern qualifier in its FY2024 auditor opinion (PwC) and is in covenant-waiver mode with Carlyle (TCG Senior Funding) on a $200M senior secured term loan maturing July 24, 2026.
claims.subject: iRobot Corp.
claims.object_value: Going-concern qualifier issued; covenant waivers until May 6, 2025; warrants for 1,840,503 shares (~6% of o/s) at $0.01 strike issued to lenders March 11, 2025
claims.source_quote: Our history of operating losses and negative cash flows from operations has raised substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern... The auditor report on the consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2024 includes an explanatory paragraph expressing substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern.

claims.claim_text: iRobot completed a workforce reduction of ~440 employees (40% of global workforce) during fiscal 2024; ended FY2024 with 541 employees vs 1,113 at end of FY2023.
claims.subject: iRobot Corp.
claims.source_quote: During fiscal 2024, we initiated an overall workforce reduction of approximately 440 employees, which represented 40% of our global workforce as of December 30, 2023. We ended fiscal 2024 with 541 employees versus 1,113 employees at the end of fiscal 2023.

claims.claim_text: iRobot's board initiated a formal strategic review on March 12, 2025 to evaluate a potential sale or strategic transaction and refinancing of debt.
claims.subject: iRobot Corp.
claims.object_value: Formal strategic review announced 2025-03-12; potential sale/refinancing under evaluation
claims.source_quote: On March 12, 2025, we announced that our board of directors has initiated a formal strategic review to evaluate a broad range of alternatives, including, but not limited to, exploring a potential sale or strategic transaction and refinancing our debt.

claims.claim_text: iRobot has an extensive patent portfolio in robotic vacuums, mops, mowers, vSLAM navigation, AI / vision-enabled robotic software.
claims.subject: iRobot Corp.
claims.object_value: Claimed extensive portfolio covering robotic vacuum/mop/mower navigation (vSLAM), AI, vision
claims.source_quote: We anticipate our extensive patent portfolio will enable us to accelerate the time to market, while also reducing the costs, time and other risks associated with product development.

claims.claim_text: iRobot has transitioned primarily to a single contract manufacturer for product assembly (asset-light supply chain).
claims.subject: iRobot Corp.
claims.object_value: Primary single contract manufacturer; contract manufacturers in Southern China, Vietnam and Malaysia
claims.source_quote: We have transitioned primarily to a single contract manufacturer, and our reputation and results of operations would be harmed if the contract manufacturer fails to meet our requirements.
